chars.YOUSSEF: YOUSSEF: a Moroccan man in his late 20s, short black hair, neat short black beard, wearing a slim charcoal-grey suit, white shirt and a bright red tie
chars.CHIKHA: CHIKHA: a Moroccan chikha dancer in her late 20s, long wavy black hair, wearing a shimmering emerald-green kaftan with a wide gold belt and gold jewelry
chars.BOSS: BOSS: a Moroccan man in his late 50s, bald head, thick grey moustache, round gold glasses, wearing a navy-blue three-piece suit with a burgundy bow tie

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a luxurious Moroccan wedding hall in Casablanca at night: YOUSSEF dances wildly and joyfully face to face with CHIKHA on the dance floor, while in the foreground at a round guest table BOSS stares at them in total shock, mouth open. Strong tension between the boss and the dancing man.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: BOSS sits stiffly at an elegant round wedding table among serious office colleagues and families in formal clothes, glass of mint tea in hand, his eyes fixed sternly toward the dance floor. Luxurious Moroccan wedding hall with zellige and chandeliers.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: YOUSSEF has tied his red tie around his forehead like a headband, jacket open, dancing with arms raised and a huge grin next to CHIKHA who laughs and claps, Moroccan musicians with violin and bendir behind them, wedding hall lights.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of BOSS frozen with his mouth wide open and eyebrows raised in disbelief, while office colleagues around him at the table laugh and cover their mouths, Moroccan wedding hall background.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Flashback, daytime: YOUSSEF sits very seriously at a tidy office desk with stacked files and a computer, checking his watch, a small prayer rug folded on the shelf behind him, calm modern office in Casablanca. He looks disciplined and serious.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: At the wedding, YOUSSEF with the red tie on his forehead proudly tucks a fan of Moroccan banknotes into the gold belt of CHIKHA as she dances, guests around them cheering and filming with phones.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: YOUSSEF walks out of the wedding hall doors into the night street, the red tie now hanging loose around his neck, hand on his forehead, embarrassed and panicking, warm light spilling from the hall behind him.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: YOUSSEF sits back down at a wedding table, shrinking in his chair, while all the guests around him, including BOSS across the table, turn and stare at him, some laughing and pointing, Moroccan wedding hall.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: YOUSSEF stands up and walks determinedly straight across the wedding hall toward CHIKHA, who turns around surprised with a raised eyebrow; guests watch in the background, dramatic moment, Moroccan wedding hall.
